title: Unsupervised Machine Learning
overview: This module contains 10 lessons from the PDF curriculum, retaining the original order and subtopics. Work through concepts, inspect examples, and document the evidence and limitations.

Apply a relevant technique to a small synthetic example and interpret the output.
Evaluate assumptions, edge cases, and limitations before communicating a conclusion.
